messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] unit-tests failing with compiled model test
parts:
You need to define assign_to_var() for fwd-mode
auto-dif vars. It basically just does an assignment.
You should only need to define the case where both
the left-hand side type is a fwd-mode auto-dif var
and the right side type is double or int.

We can talk more about this tomorrow.

- Bob

messages.subject: separating dependencies
parts:
The recently pushed

src/stan/agrad/rev/matrix/assign_to_var.hpp

lives in agrad/rev, but has this include:

#include <stan/agrad/fwd/fvar.hpp>

There shouldn't be includes of fwd from rev. In this case,
this include's not doing anything, so I just removed it.

As an illustration of my previous point (that I'm as
much to blame for bad commits as anyone, if not more so),
this whole file's in the wrong place, which was my doing.

We'll move it so the assign is at the top level and just
deals with scalars and std::vector. Then we'll have one
that does promotion for reverse-model LHS in agrad/rev
and another one for fwd-mode in agrad/fwd.
